_comment: One entry per real plant and its NFC tag. tag_uid is uppercase hex with no separators, exactly as the ESP32 sends it on incube/pad/A and incube/pad/B. The plant follows its tag: put the tag on either pad and that plant is summoned. Level and XP are not stored here; they live in data/progress.db on the Jetson. Moves refer to data/moves.json, one per category. skill must match the skill move's skill_key.
